notes.title: Update 6.73 is released!
notes.content:
Power & Revolution 2021 Edition
Update 6.73

Main corrections and improvements:

-Recalculation of specific erroneous territorial waters for port constructions, assignment of maritime wind turbines, access to maritime bases, movement of maritime units, etc.)
-Correction on calculation of economic growth problem which particularly affected the smallest countries (like Palestine or others)
-Corrections electoral process in Turkey
-Restore surveillance of personalities
-Free trade agreement opening correction when selecting an organization in the free trade panel
-Taking into account the fulfillment of various promises of electoral program
-Adjustment of political trends for certain countries (Argentina, Bolivia, ...)
-Correction on display of the distance of TGV networks in the Transport panel
-Gay rights updates for some countries
-Validation of access to the black market from the Army Budget tab
-Japan reestablished in the G20
-Access to the black market of weapons from Army / Budget
-Adjustments on certain geopolitical alignments
-Access to NGO files
-Adjustment of minimums when joining the euro
-Restore the radius of the satellites in medium level of detail
-Adjustment of the number of supporters of the anti-racism association
-Addition of wind turbines in Portugal and update of its electrical distribution
-Repositioning and reallocation of cities in Kosovo
-Repositioning Lithuanian cities in their region
-Onshore wind repositioning in Lithuania
-Adjustment of the calculation of food crises
-EU funding display setting
-Added various missing translations
-Addition of people's demonstrations according to the vaccination policy
-Fixed random crash following the total destruction of Police HQ
-Detection of native resolution if Windows is configured with lower DPI.
-Reducing the impact of a severe recession on the level of inflation
-Correction on the validation of the formation of a majority coalition after an election in parliamentary system
-Revalidation of the surveillance of terrorist files
-Modification of the output calculation of cancer-themed queries
-Correction on the % of success of space programs
-Correction on proposed peace agreement with illegal organization
-Correction on UN vote
-Correction on the calculation of the immunity rate according to the vaccination rate
-Evolution of inflation in the regions that have become independent
-Stop vaccine deliveries in Europe when the epidemic is over
-Update of electoral results in party files
-Adjustment of the calculation of the number of seats in parliament for the member parties of the ruling coalition and managed by the IA, during a general election in parliamentary regime
-Correction of production data for some sectors in comparison maps
-Correction on the customization of the national anthem
-Adjustment calculation of deaths related to breast cancer
-Added sorting of columns in Debt panels
-Correction of GDP boost after making a free trade agreement with a newly created economic organization
-Update of the population of Germany 
-Update of several data in New Zealand 
-Correction of the drop in the number of soldiers following massive hiring in the economic sectors 
-Evolution of inflation in the regions that have become independent 
-Correction on hurricanes and cyclones 
-Fixed tank shell firing in city battles 
-Various corrections

We would like to thank the entire community and beta testers for their collaboration in improving the game. 

If you encounter any bugs or inaccuracies in the game, or if you have suggestions for improvements, do not hesitate to contact us: on support@power-and-revolution.com (technical problems) or on contact@power-and-revolution.com (other problems or suggestions)

notes.title: Patch v6.72
notes.content:
